meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Hail Mary
meta.description: I am a Doll that makes the impossible possible.

units.rawText: Data recovery 90% complete.
units.displayText: Data recovery 90% complete.

spans.text: Data recovery 90% complete.

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: Oh no... they broke through the thin spot on the operand barrier's east flank!
units.displayText: Oh no... they broke through the thin spot on the operand barrier's east flank!

spans.text: Oh no... they broke through the thin spot on the operand barrier's east flank!

units.rawText: Alarms ring throughout the base as device after device goes offline on the status monitors.
units.displayText: Alarms ring throughout the base as device after device goes offline on the status monitors.

spans.text: Alarms ring throughout the base as device after device goes offline on the status monitors.

units.rawText: Warning— entropic entities have entered the base. Entrance No. 3 and the Kepler Laboratory are showing signs of entropization.
units.displayText: Warning— entropic entities have entered the base. Entrance No. 3 and the Kepler Laboratory are showing signs of entropization.

spans.text: Warning— entropic entities have entered the base. Entrance No. 3 and the Kepler Laboratory are showing signs of entropization.

units.rawText: Ops Room has lost control over Entrance No. 3's gate...
units.displayText: Ops Room has lost control over Entrance No. 3's gate...

spans.text: Ops Room has lost control over Entrance No. 3's gate...

units.rawText: Tsk... the entropization's spreading too fast!
units.displayText: Tsk... the entropization's spreading too fast!

spans.text: Tsk... the entropization's spreading too fast!

units.rawText: I need to protect the core region, if nothing else. At least until the data transfer finishes...
units.displayText: I need to protect the core region, if nothing else. At least until the data transfer finishes...

spans.text: I need to protect the core region, if nothing else. At least until the data transfer finishes...

units.rawText: Entrance No. 3, the Kepler lab... in that case, the next place the entropization will be spreading to is... the generator complex?!
units.displayText: Entrance No. 3, the Kepler lab... in that case, the next place the entropization will be spreading to is... the generator complex?!

spans.text: Entrance No. 3, the Kepler lab... in that case, the next place the entropization will be spreading to is... the generator complex?!

units.rawText: The lights in the corridor begin flashing, as though to confirm Yuwang's guess. This is immediately followed by system alerts going off.
units.displayText: The lights in the corridor begin flashing, as though to confirm Yuwang's guess. This is immediately followed by system alerts going off.

spans.text: The lights in the corridor begin flashing, as though to confirm Yuwang's guess. This is immediately followed by system alerts going off.

units.rawText: Warning— Entropization of base power systems detected. Power supply from No. 4 generator  has been cut off. Unable to activate backup power supply.
units.displayText: Warning— Entropization of base power systems detected. Power supply from No. 4 generator  has been cut off. Unable to activate backup power supply.

spans.text: Warning— Entropization of base power systems detected. Power supply from No. 4 generator  has been cut off. Unable to activate backup power supply.

units.rawText: Generator Room 4's been entropized already? Xinghuan's lab is getting power from Generator 6...
units.displayText: Generator Room 4's been entropized already? Xinghuan's lab is getting power from Generator 6...

spans.text: Generator Room 4's been entropized already? Xinghuan's lab is getting power from Generator 6...

units.rawText: And if it loses power, the data transfer will be interrupted... We need to stop the entropics from getting in there!
units.displayText: And if it loses power, the data transfer will be interrupted... We need to stop the entropics from getting in there!

spans.text: And if it loses power, the data transfer will be interrupted... We need to stop the entropics from getting in there!

units.rawText: Yuwang turns his wheelchair toward the generator room, but he is interrupted by a familiar voice.
units.displayText: Yuwang turns his wheelchair toward the generator room, but he is interrupted by a familiar voice.

spans.text: Yuwang turns his wheelchair toward the generator room, but he is interrupted by a familiar voice.

units.rawText: Objective confirmed, Generator No. 6. Yuwang, Ops Room.
units.displayText: Objective confirmed, Generator No. 6. Yuwang, Ops Room.

spans.text: Objective confirmed, Generator No. 6. Yuwang, Ops Room.

units.rawText: We, repair equipment. Yuwang, Ops Room.
units.displayText: We, repair equipment. Yuwang, Ops Room.

spans.text: We, repair equipment. Yuwang, Ops Room.

units.rawText: What... you... What are you doing?! Didn't I tell you to evacuate already?!
units.displayText: What... you... What are you doing?! Didn't I tell you to evacuate already?!

spans.text: What... you... What are you doing?! Didn't I tell you to evacuate already?!

units.rawText: Titan, home. Xinghuan, friend, family.
units.displayText: Titan, home. Xinghuan, friend, family.

spans.text: Titan, home. Xinghuan, friend, family.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, saving data. We, protect Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, saving data. We, protect Xinghuan.

spans.text: Xinghuan, saving data. We, protect Xinghuan.

units.rawText: Save the science, save the sector, save our friend.
units.displayText: Save the science, save the sector, save our friend.

spans.text: Save the science, save the sector, save our friend.

units.rawText: The research mini-robots gather around Yuwang's wheelchair, looking at him with determination in their eyes.
units.displayText: The research mini-robots gather around Yuwang's wheelchair, looking at him with determination in their eyes.

spans.text: The research mini-robots gather around Yuwang's wheelchair, looking at him with determination in their eyes.

units.rawText: Outside, attacks continue pouring down on the barrier. The clamor is deafening. Yuwang knows that he can't hesitate any longer.
units.displayText: Outside, attacks continue pouring down on the barrier. The clamor is deafening. Yuwang knows that he can't hesitate any longer.

spans.text: Outside, attacks continue pouring down on the barrier. The clamor is deafening. Yuwang knows that he can't hesitate any longer.

units.rawText: Return in triumph, victory to Jiutian.
units.displayText: Return in triumph, victory to Jiutian.

spans.text: Return in triumph, victory to Jiutian.

units.rawText: Yeah, I'll let you guys handle it.
units.displayText: Yeah, I'll let you guys handle it.

spans.text: Yeah, I'll let you guys handle it.

units.rawText: The research mini-robots organize themselves into a small expedition that enters the tunnels on the outskirts of the base, heading for the generator complex. Yuwang returns to the Ops Room.
units.displayText: The research mini-robots organize themselves into a small expedition that enters the tunnels on the outskirts of the base, heading for the generator complex. Yuwang returns to the Ops Room.

spans.text: The research mini-robots organize themselves into a small expedition that enters the tunnels on the outskirts of the base, heading for the generator complex. Yuwang returns to the Ops Room.

units.rawText: Massive meteor shower detected on base outskirts, direction 12 o'clock, range 202!
units.displayText: Massive meteor shower detected on base outskirts, direction 12 o'clock, range 202!

spans.text: Massive meteor shower detected on base outskirts, direction 12 o'clock, range 202!

units.rawText: Prioritize the use of the base's operand supply for repair of the defensive barrier. Ready Positron Annihilator Cannon 2. Target direction: 12 o'clock, range: 200...
units.displayText: Prioritize the use of the base's operand supply for repair of the defensive barrier. Ready Positron Annihilator Cannon 2. Target direction: 12 o'clock, range: 200...

spans.text: Prioritize the use of the base's operand supply for repair of the defensive barrier. Ready Positron Annihilator Cannon 2. Target direction: 12 o'clock, range: 200...

units.rawText: <size=60>FIRE!!</size>
units.displayText: FIRE!!

spans.text: FIRE!!

units.rawText: A beam of light lances through the cloud and hits the massive meteor shower as it falls through the air. Debris rains down from the blackened clouds.
units.displayText: A beam of light lances through the cloud and hits the massive meteor shower as it falls through the air. Debris rains down from the blackened clouds.

spans.text: A beam of light lances through the cloud and hits the massive meteor shower as it falls through the air. Debris rains down from the blackened clouds.

units.rawText: Xinghuan... You need to hurry it up!
units.displayText: Xinghuan... You need to hurry it up!

spans.text: Xinghuan... You need to hurry it up!
